title: Add RAG storybook: curated scenario samples + component playbook
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Adds a Storybook-style RAG scenario gallery and a lightweight playbook for authoring reusable agent components. Includes playback harness for deterministic scenario replay and a short migration note for docs consumers.
description:
Motivation: Teams repeatedly ask for concrete, composable RAG examples that can be inspected and replayed in the docs without cloning full quickstart repos. This PR introduces a Storybook-inspired gallery of short RAG 'stories' (scenarios) and a component playbook that documents common tool-call patterns, prompt templates, and safe fallbacks.

What this changes: Adds a docs-first examples surface that can be embedded in the docs site and run in a CI-backed playback harness. The goal is to help engineers iterate on tool-call wiring and prompt fragments with short, deterministic runs rather than full integration tests. This is intentionally lightweight and intended to complement—not replace—existing quickstarts.

Checklist:
- [x] Add story artifacts (scenario manifests + seed corpora)
- [x] Implement playback harness with deterministic mock connectors
- [x] Add component-level docs for tool-call skeletons and structured output assertions
- [x] Wire story gallery into docs site navigation and add a short authoring guide
- [x] CI smoke tests for story playback and docs build

Commits summary: single-squash merge composed of focused commits: initial story scaffolding, playback harness, story gallery UI, component playbook pages, docs nav wiring, CI pipeline additions. See commits field for high-level messages.

Changed areas (high level):
- docs/storybook/ : new scenario manifests, README, authoring guide, seed data
- docs/components/rag-playbook.md : playbook content for tool-calling patterns and structured outputs
- site/src/pages/docs/rag-gallery.tsx : gallery UI to browse and run stories inside the docs app
- infra/ci/story-harness.yml : CI job to run playback harness on PRs to docs
- examples/mocks/* : deterministic mock connectors for API and vector store calls

Review conversation (high-level): Reviewer Luca Martinez: "Nice. The deterministic seeds are critical — can we ensure the playback harness records and replays random seeds from the same PR run?" Author (Priya): "Yes — harness persists PR-run seed metadata to artifacts; added docs and test coverage. See commit 3 for implementation." Reviewer Asha Patel: "Docs look clear; suggest a short how-to for converting an existing quickstart into a story." Author: "Added conversion guide under docs/storybook/convert.md." Reviewer Dmitri: "CI job is green; small nit: prefer .mdx for playbook to enable live components." Author: "Converted rag-playbook to .mdx and updated imports." Approvals: Luca and Asha approved after changes; Dmitri approved once CI green.

CI summary: docs-build: pass; story-playback-smoke: pass (runs minimal playback suite against mocks); lint: pass; storybook-smoke: pass (headless). A single intermittent flake in story-playback observed on initial run and fixed by locking test vector seed in harness.

Merge outcome: merged via squash on 2026-02-25 after all approvals and CI green.

Notes for maintainers: The playback harness uses a shrinkwrap of mock connectors in examples/mocks. If you update connector shapes, please add a thin compatibility shim in examples/mocks to avoid breaking story playback in the docs CI.
